createdAt.description: The timestamp when the notification was created

createdById.description: The ID of the user who created the notification

destinationId.description: The ID of the user who should receive the notification

id.description: The unique identifier of the notification

link.description: A link associated with the notification

read.description: Indicates if the notification has been read

readAt.description: The timestamp when the notification was read

tenantId.description: The ID of the tenant this notification belongs to
